about: Fields of data/handling.cfg (GTA San Andreas 1.0) for satk.addon: one entry per value in file order after the handling id. key = satk name (satk.formats.handling), col = column letter of the file header, name = the usual handling-editor name, mta = MTA setModelHandling property (absent = MTA cannot set it), type f float | i int | x hex | c letter, unit, range = typical values of the vanilla file, limit = values the engine accepts (patch warns outside), desc = what it does.

id.desc: Handling id: the name the vehicles.ide line refers to (its 5th field). The stock engine only knows 210 fixed ids of up to 13 characters (cHandlingDataMgr::VehicleNames); a new id needs a limit adjuster that accepts new handling names (fastman92 LA).

car.title: standard vehicle line (every vehicle has one)

bike.title: bike line: extra data for bikes, BMX and quads

boat.title: boat line: extra data for boats (and the seaplane)

flying.title: flying line: extra data for planes, helicopters and RC aircraft

car.name: fMass
car.desc: Vehicle mass. Heavier vehicles push lighter ones aside and need more engine and brake force for the same acceleration.

car.name: fTurnMass
car.desc: Rotational inertia: how hard the body is to spin or turn. Too low makes the vehicle spin out; too high makes it feel numb.

car.name: fDragMult
car.desc: Air drag multiplier. Higher means a lower top speed and faster slowing down when coasting.

car.name: vecCentreOfMass.x
car.desc: Centre of mass, X offset (to the right) from the model origin.

car.name: vecCentreOfMass.y
car.desc: Centre of mass, Y offset (forward). Forward weight helps braking stability, rearward weight helps traction of RWD cars.

car.name: vecCentreOfMass.z
car.desc: Centre of mass, Z offset (up). Lower values make the vehicle harder to roll over.

car.name: nPercentSubmerged
car.desc: How deep the vehicle floats in water, as a percentage of its height; above 100 it sinks.

car.name: fTractionMultiplier
car.desc: Overall tyre grip. Higher means more grip in corners and at launch. Boats use it as the bank force multiplier.

car.name: fTractionLoss
car.desc: Grip kept while the wheels slip under hard acceleration or braking; lower means more wheelspin and sliding. Boats use it as the rudder turn force.

car.name: fTractionBias
car.desc: Split of grip between the axles: 1.0 all at the front, 0.0 all at the rear, 0.5 even. Boats use it as the speed steer falloff.

car.name: nNumberOfGears
car.desc: Number of forward gears; sets the gear change points and the engine sound pattern.

car.name: fMaxVelocity
car.desc: Top speed the gearing allows; the reachable top speed also depends on drag and engine acceleration.

car.name: fEngineAcceleration
car.desc: Engine acceleration in the file's units (the engine scales it on load). Higher means quicker acceleration.

car.name: fEngineInertia
car.desc: How slowly engine power builds up and falls off; higher feels heavier and smooths gear changes.

car.name: nDriveType
car.desc: Driven wheels: F front, R rear, 4 all four.

car.name: nEngineType
car.desc: Engine type: P petrol, D diesel, E electric.

car.name: fBrakeDeceleration
car.desc: Brake strength; higher stops sooner. Too high locks the wheels.

car.name: fBrakeBias
car.desc: Split of brake force: 1.0 front only, 0.0 rear only. More rear bias makes the car slide under braking.

car.name: bABS
car.desc: Anti-lock brakes flag; has little or no effect in San Andreas.

car.name: fSteeringLock
car.desc: Largest steering angle of the front wheels.

car.name: fSuspensionForceLevel
car.desc: Spring stiffness; higher is stiffer and rides higher.

car.name: fSuspensionDampingLevel
car.desc: Damping of the springs; higher bounces less, too high makes the ride harsh.

car.name: fSuspensionHighSpdComDamp
car.desc: Extra compression damping at high speed; usually 0, high values for bouncy vehicles.

car.name: fSuspensionUpperLimit
car.desc: How far the wheels can rise into the body.

car.name: fSuspensionLowerLimit
car.desc: How far the wheels hang down (negative); together with the upper limit it sets the ride height.

car.name: fSuspensionBiasBetweenFrontAndRear
car.desc: Split of spring strength between front and rear; above 0.5 the front is stiffer.

car.name: fSuspensionAntiDiveMultiplier
car.desc: Resistance to the body pitching forward under braking and back under acceleration; 0 lets it pitch fully.

car.name: fSeatOffsetDistance
car.desc: How far the driver's seat position is moved from the door towards the centre of the vehicle.

car.name: fCollisionDamageMultiplier
car.desc: Damage the vehicle takes from collisions.

car.name: nMonetaryValue
car.desc: Value of the vehicle, used by the statistics of property damage.

car.name: modelFlags
car.desc: Body and model behaviour bits (written in hex): van, bus, low, doors, boot, axles, bike/heli/plane/boat, double rear wheels, hatchback. See 'satk data explain handling modelFlags'.

car.name: handlingFlags
car.desc: Driving behaviour bits (written in hex): boosts, steering of the rear wheels, wheel widths, hydraulics, nitro, off-road ability, lowrider, street racer. See 'satk data explain handling handlingFlags'.

car.name: frontLights
car.desc: Headlight style: 0 long, 1 small, 2 big, 3 tall.

car.name: rearLights
car.desc: Tail light style: 0 long, 1 small, 2 big, 3 tall.

car.name: animGroup
car.desc: Vehicle anim group (the '^' lines of handling.cfg): how peds get in, sit and get out (car, van, bike, truck, ...).

bike.name: fLeanFwdCOM
bike.desc: Centre of mass shift when the rider leans forward.

bike.name: fLeanFwdForce
bike.desc: Force applied when leaning forward (helps stoppies).

bike.name: fLeanBakCOM
bike.desc: Centre of mass shift when the rider leans back.

bike.name: fLeanBackForce
bike.desc: Force applied when leaning back (helps wheelies).

bike.name: fFullAnimLean
bike.desc: Lean angle at which the rider animation is fully leaned.

bike.name: fDesLean
bike.desc: How quickly the bike reaches the lean the steering asks for.

bike.name: fSpeedSteer
bike.desc: How much steering is reduced at speed.

bike.name: fNoPlayerCOMz
bike.desc: Change of the centre of mass height when nobody rides the bike.

boat.name: fThrustZ
boat.desc: Upward part of the thrust (lifts the bow).

boat.name: fThrustAppZ
boat.desc: Height at which the thrust is applied.

boat.name: fAqPlaneOffset
boat.desc: Where along the hull the aquaplaning lift acts.

boat.name: vecMoveRes.x
boat.desc: Water resistance to sideways movement (close to 1 = little damping).

boat.name: fLook_L_R_BehindCamHeight
boat.desc: Camera height when looking left, right or behind.

flying.name: fYawStab
flying.desc: Yaw stability: tendency to straighten out.

flying.name: fRollStab
flying.desc: Roll stability: tendency to level the wings.

flying.name: fAttackLift
flying.desc: Lift from the angle of attack.

flying.name: fGearUpR
flying.desc: Air resistance with the landing gear up.

flying.name: fGearDownL
flying.desc: Lift change with the landing gear down.

flying.name: fWindMult
flying.desc: How much wind moves the aircraft.

flying.name: fMoveRes
flying.desc: Air resistance to movement (close to 1 = little damping).

model_flags.name: REVERSE_BONNET
model_flags.desc: bonnet style: reversed (opens from the front)

model_flags.name: FORCE_DOOR_CHECK
model_flags.desc: force a door check when getting in

handling_flags.name: OFFROAD_ABILITY2
handling_flags.desc: better on sand and soft ground

handling_flags.name: USE_MAXSP_LIMIT
handling_flags.desc: hard limit at the max velocity

handling_flags.name: STREET_RACER
handling_flags.desc: street racer: Wheel Arch Angels upgrades
